revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, showing a narrow service hallway with utility doors, exposed pipes, matte concrete non-glossy floor, and warm practical interior lighting. Right-oblique view at medium distance, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. A clearly visible middle-aged adult of medium build wearing a tan utility jacket and dark jeans, in brown and cream clothing, repairing something from a one-knee kneel, with hips and legs supporting the posture and shoulders above the ground. Plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, not cinematic or advertising. Include a column or partition partly framing one side of the image. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or annotation.
